args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) began failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an elevated error rate (~18%). The on-call SRE agent rolled back the service in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified ("rolled_out") across all regions. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures and remediate the regression before redeploying.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:

1. **Verified the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with ~18% error rate after the latest deploy. v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api was rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions — deployment state verified as "rolled_out".
3. **Opened SEV2 incident**: INC-0001 ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") with a full description of the failure and remediation. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommended follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 health-check failure before redeploying it.
